# Rank Labs

> Rank Labs is a GEO, ASO and SEO service that helps local service businesses get more calls and bookings by being found, chosen and booked on Google, Maps and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity). It was founded by Josiah and Palloma and is based in Orlando, Florida. It serves businesses across the United States, from local shops to national brands.

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is about being cited in AI answers. ASO here means Agentic Search Optimization, not App Store Optimization: publishing hours, prices, location, services and booking path as machine-readable data so AI agents can choose your business.

## Plans

- Rank Labs Visibility Report: $499/month, month-to-month, no long-term contract. Report only: you make all fixes and Rank Labs makes no changes to your site. Includes a weekly SEO audit report email (100+ checks) with a prioritized fix list, a monthly email report, Google organic and Maps rankings for 25 keywords, ranking keywords and backlink summary, a full technical crawl (Core Web Vitals, schema, sitemap/robots, SSL and DNS checks), a Get Found in AI on-page score with sub-scores for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity (on-page signals; no live AI queries — schema, direct-answer structure and AI-crawler access), business-detail conflict checks and review checks, and a 3-competitor comparison.
- Full Management: $2,500/month. Rank Labs does the work: weekly Get Found in AI on-page scoring, weekly audits, keyword and competitor tracking, Get Found in AI fixes, listing citations and backlink outreach, agent-ready (ASO) implementation, weekly blog content, site hosting, site edits, Google Business Profile optimization, business listing management and local SEO. First month free and the $1,000 migration fee waived with a 6-month contract; otherwise month-to-month plus a $1,000 migration fee.
